property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list and any call to C.transfer, every external low-level call made by C must carry exactly 100 bytes of calldata: the 4-byte selector 0x23b872dd followed by three ABI-encoded words (from, recipient, amount); the mutant instead sends a different selector and only 96 bytes, violating this rule for any admissible input.
change_summary: Change the selector hash string to transferFrom(address,address,uint), making the encoded selector differ from the original.
